Gamma would turn burned subnet alpha into dollar-valued credits for services. The same release integrates quantum-resistant wallet code. Our finalized check still shows runtime 486, so deployment and feature enablement remain separate milestones.

Also in today’s report:

• SN58 Attune: Horizon’s robot-data platform and its documented 70% route from the miner bucket. Payouts remain unverified.
• SN38 ChronoLLM: a 16B point-in-time model preview, with weights still forthcoming.
• SN108 ChipForge: replace a queued design without losing its place.
• SN53 engy: Kimi K3.1 Pro catalog access and published pricing.
• SN91 Cascade: a coordinated, gated worker upgrade.

Plus dated SN9 IOTA and SN127 Zils follow-ups, refreshed owner holdings and both chain archives. Sources, actual dates and access gaps:

added.headline: SN75 Hippius adds share-link comments and viewing insights
added.summary: Hippius announced the sharing update on November 5 at 09:23 UTC. Its documentation describes comments, reactions and per-link viewing insights for shared captures. The privacy boundary matters: comments are encrypted with the link key, while reactions and view counts are not encrypted; ordinary link previews also expose the preview image and filename. Owners can toggle these features per link, and detailed recording analytics depend on the plan. This is a documented collaboration feature, not an independently audited security guarantee.

added.headline: SN46 Instant merges overlapping signer support for validator key rotation
added.summary: Instant merged validator PR13 on November 5 at 17:18 UTC. PLATFORM_SIGNER can now contain a comma-separated list of approved SS58 keys, letting operators retain an old signer while introducing a new one. Summaries must be signed by a listed key, and verification logs identify which signer was used. This provides an overlap mechanism for key rotation; the merge does not establish that operators have deployed it or that an actual platform-key rotation occurred.

added.headline: SN127 Zils merges disk-space safeguards for model-pool intake
added.summary: Zils merged PR207 on November 5 at 20:12 UTC. The change reduces retention of graded model bodies after they leave the pool from three rounds to one, retaining hashes and sketches, and adds a 60 GiB free-disk floor plus room for the largest model body. Intake below the threshold is deferred to a later round without a failure or backoff penalty; ungraded models awaiting retry retain their weights. This changes validator storage management and miner admission behavior in code. Deployment across validators was not verified.
